myProfileSummary: I am Matsepe Kgodiso, a software developer and founder of FindRooms, an accommodation platform. With Meta Front-End and Back-End Developer certificates, I build full-stack web applications using JavaScript, React, Node.js, Express, and Python. I enjoy solving real-world problems through technology and turning ideas into practical digital solutions. I am eager to contribute my technical skills, entrepreneurial mindset, and passion for software development to a collaborative development team.
